recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current FHIR core source edit is needed for FHIR-24679; future failures of the external fhir.org registry page or redirects should be handled as website/infrastructure work outside this source tree.
issue_request: FHIR-24679 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core issue, auto-approved for R5, reporting that the build.fhir.org homepage bottom-left link labeled 'Published by HL7, Affiliates & FHIR Foundation' to http://www.fhir.org/guides/registry redirected to the obsolete http://fhir-org.fhir-ehws.net.au/guides/registry/ target.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-24679 was found. The historical homepage link family changed through c5859b35be6074438d35c3d28b104350d4054c73, which introduced the guides/registry destination for the old visible label, and bc0c3d8207aaec46b99155b3946a776e4d3c545c, which replaced the old visible label with 'Curated list of Implementation Guides' and added registry.fhir.org to the homepage link cluster before R5.
additional_context: A directly relevant 2019 Zulip implementers thread reported the same visible link concern and attributed the problem to external fhir.org registry page/browser-cache behavior. Current source searches found no fhir-org.fhir-ehws.net.au host or old homepage label. Current HTTP checks show fhir.org/guides/registry returns 200 after HTTPS redirects. Same-family FHIR-20734 and background FHIR-23809 are already represented on the combined branch, so they were not decided again.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active homepage source in source/index.html links the Implementation Guides section to http://www.fhir.org/guides/registry, https://registry.fhir.org/, and https://packages2.fhir.org/xig with current labels, and the obsolete external redirect target reported by FHIR-24679 is absent from current source.
